info.description: A comprehensive file server API built with Go. It supports file and folder management, sharing, real-time updates via WebSockets, and more. All protected endpoints require a Bearer Token for authorization.
info.title: File Server API

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a short-lived access token and a long-lived refresh token.
Provides a new short-lived access token and a new refresh token in exchange for a valid, non-expired refresh token. Implements refresh token rotation.

400.description: Invalid request body or missing token

get.description: Retrieves a list of events that have occurred since a given event ID. Used for client-side cache synchronization.

parameters.description: The ID of the last event received. Omit or use 0 to get all events.
parameters.name: since

get.description: Retrieves a list of all files and folders marked as favorite by the current user.
Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user from their JWT token.

patch.description: Updates properties of the currently authenticated user, such as their display name.

Allows the authenticated user to change their own password. The new password must be at least 8 characters long. Upon successful password change, all other active sessions for the user will be terminated for security reasons.

400.description: Bad Request - New password is weak (less than 8 characters) or empty

401.description: Unauthorized - Old password does not match

get.description: Retrieves the current storage usage and quota for the authenticated user.
Lists the user's own files and folders in a specified parent folder or in the root directory.

parameters.description: ID of the parent folder to list. Omit for root.
parameters.name: parent_id

get.description: Downloads multiple files and/or folders as a single ZIP archive.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of Node IDs to include in the archive
parameters.name: ids

404.description: Not Found - one of the nodes does not exist

post.description: Uploads one or more files. If uploaded inside a shared folder with write permissions, the folder's owner becomes the owner of the new file(s). The total size of the request payload cannot exceed 1GB. Exceeding the owner's storage quota will result in an error.

parameters.description: The file(s) to upload. Can be provided multiple times.
parameters.name: file

404.description: Not Found - Parent folder not found

413.description: Payload Too Large - either the request exceeds 1GB or the owner's storage quota is exceeded.

post.description: Creates a new folder. If created inside a shared folder with write permissions, the folder's owner becomes the owner of the new folder. Otherwise, the creator is the owner.

404.description: Not Found - Parent folder not found

409.description: Conflict - a folder with the same name already exists

delete.description: Moves a file or a folder (and its contents) to the trash (soft delete). Requires write permission in the folder containing the node. The node is moved to its owner's trash.

parameters.description: Node ID to move to trash
parameters.name: nodeId

patch.description: Updates a node's properties, such as its name or parent folder. To move a node to the root directory, provide "root" as the parent_id. Moving nodes between different owners is not allowed. Requires write permission in the source and target folders.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid operation (e.g., moving between owners, circular move)

post.description: Creates a deep copy of a file or folder (and its contents) to a new location. By default, the copy retains the original name. If a node with the same name already exists in the target location, a 409 Conflict error is returned. An optional 'new_name' can be provided for the top-level copied node. The new node inherits the owner of the target folder. Use "root" for the target ParentID.

parameters.description: Node ID of the file/folder to copy
parameters.name: nodeId

parameters.description: Target parent folder and optional new name
parameters.name: copyRequest

404.description: Not Found - Source or destination not found

409.description: Conflict - A node with the same name already exists in the target location

413.description: Payload Too Large - Not enough storage space

get.description: Downloads a single file by its ID.

parameters.description: Node ID of the file to download
parameters.name: nodeId

400.description: Bad Request - Cannot download a folder

post.description: Marks a file or folder as a favorite for the current user.

parameters.description: Node ID to add to favorites
parameters.name: nodeId

404.description: Not Found - Node does not exist or user lacks access

409.description: Conflict - Node is already in favorites

delete.description: Removes a file or folder from the current user's list of favorites.

parameters.description: Node ID to remove from favorites
parameters.name: nodeId

post.description: Restores a file or folder from the trash to its original location. Fails if a node with the same name already exists in the target location.

409.description: Conflict - a node with the same name already exists in the original location

post.description: Shares a file or folder with another user, granting them read or write permissions.

404.description: Not Found - Node or recipient not found

409.description: Conflict - Node is already shared with this user

get.description: Searches for nodes (files and folders) by name across the user's own space and all items shared with them.
Gets a list of all active sessions for the currently authenticated user. This can be used to display a list of devices where the user is logged in.

post.description: Terminates all active sessions for the currently authenticated user, effectively logging them out from all devices. This will also close all active WebSocket connections for the user.

delete.description: Terminates (logs out) a specific session by its ID. A user can only terminate their own sessions. This will also close any active WebSocket connections associated with the terminated user.

parameters.description: ID of the session to terminate
parameters.name: sessionId

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid session ID format

get.description: Lists files and folders shared with the current user by a specific sharer. Can list the root of shared items or the content of a subfolder.
get.summary: List items shared by a user

parameters.description: Username of the person who shared the content
parameters.name: sharer_username

parameters.description: ID of the shared parent folder to list. Omit for the root of shared items.
parameters.name: parent_id

get.description: Gets a unique list of users who have shared one or more items with the currently authenticated user. This is the root level for the "Shared with me" view.
get.summary: List users who shared with me

get.description: Gets a list of all items the currently authenticated user has shared with others.

delete.description: Revokes a share entry. Only the original sharer can do this.

parameters.description: ID of the share to delete
parameters.name: shareId

get.description: Retrieves a list of all files and folders currently in the user's trash.

delete.description: Permanently deletes all files and folders from the user's trash. This action cannot be undone.

get.description: Upgrades an HTTP connection to a WebSocket connection for real-time updates. The access token must be provided as a query parameter.
